text.aria-label: Title text 'Pretraining and B-mix raise CRPS; the 5-seed pool and the wider network lower it Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling origin days (interim: 4 months). Clean half-hours, 5 seeds, 1.15 widening. Each arm minus the single-network S1; the dashed line is S1. The 3-seed pool is compared with seeds 0 to 2 of S1, every other arm with all 5 seeds.'
text.tspan: Pretraining and B-mix raise CRPS; the 5-seed pool and the wider network lower it
Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling origin days (interim: 4 months). Clean half-hours, 5 seeds, 1.15
widening. Each arm minus the single-network S1; the dashed line is S1. The 3-seed pool is compared with seeds 0 to 2
of S1, every other arm with all 5 seeds.
